spring:
  application:
    name: javaExperience
  datasource:
    # compose.yaml의 mysql(호스트 13308 → 컨테이너 3306)의 community DB(시나리오용). 앱을 띄우기 전에 docker compose up -d
    url: jdbc:mysql://localhost:13308/community?characterEncoding=UTF-8&serverTimezone=Asia/Seoul
    username: community
    password: community
  jpa:
    hibernate:
      # 테이블은 docker/mysql/init/ 의 dump가 만든다. 엔티티가 테이블과 다르면 기동이 실패한다(테이블을 몰래 바꾸지 않음)
      ddl-auto: validate
    # 트랜잭션이 끝나면 커넥션을 바로 반납한다(컨트롤러·직렬화 단계까지 붙잡지 않음)
    open-in-view: false
    properties:
      hibernate:
        format_sql: true

logging:
  level:
    # 실행 SQL은 확인하되 토큰을 포함한 바인딩 값은 로그에 남기지 않는다
    org.hibernate.SQL: debug
    org.hibernate.orm.jdbc.bind: info
mybatis:
  mapper-locations: classpath:mapper/*.xml
  configuration:
    map-underscore-to-camel-case: true

# 0-6 — 내가 정한 설정 값. 코드에서 @Value("${start.greeting}")로 읽는다
start:
  greeting: 반가워요, 백엔드!
  max-items: 5

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.like.MyBatisLikeMapper">
    <select id="findPostStatus" resultType="string">
        SELECT status FROM post WHERE id = #{postId}
    </select>
    <select id="existsLike" resultType="boolean">
        SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_like
                      WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND member_id = #{memberId})
    </select>
    <insert id="insertLike">
        INSERT INTO post_like(post_id, member_id, created_at)
        VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
    </insert>
    <update id="increaseLikeCount">
        UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{postId}
    </update>
</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.post.PostReplaceMapper">
    <select id="findTagByName" resultType="org.example.post.PostReplaceTagRow">
        SELECT id, name FROM tag WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
    </select>
    <insert id="insertTagIfMissing">
        INSERT INTO tag(name, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
    </insert>
    <update id="softDelete">
        UPDATE post SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
    </update>
    <update id="patchPost">
        UPDATE post
        <set>
            <if test="title != null">title = #{title},</if>
            <if test="content != null">content = #{content},</if>
            <if test="visibility != null">visibility = #{visibility},</if>
            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        </set>
        WHERE id = #{id}
    </update>
    <update id="updatePost">
        UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content},
                        visibility = #{visibility}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = #{id}
    </update>
    <delete id="deletePostTags">
        DELETE FROM post_tag WHERE post_id = #{postId}
    </delete>
    <insert id="insertPostTag">
        INSERT INTO post_tag(post_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{tagId})
    </insert>
</mapper>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.post.PostVisibilityMapper">
    <sql id="listWhere">
        p.board_id = #{boardId}
        AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
        AND (p.visibility = 'PUBLIC'
             <if test="viewerId != null">
                OR p.author_id = #{viewerId}
                OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follow f
                           WHERE f.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f.followee_id = p.author_id)
             </if>)
        <if test="viewerId != null">
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_block b
                            WHERE (b.blocker_id = #{viewerId} AND b.blocked_id = p.author_id)
                               OR (b.blocked_id = #{viewerId} AND b.blocker_id = p.author_id))
        </if>
    </sql>

    <select id="findVisibleDetail" resultType="org.example.post.PostDetailRow">
        SELECT p.id, b.slug AS board_slug, p.title, p.content, p.visibility,
               m.id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname,
               p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.created_at
        FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.id = p.board_id
                    JOIN member m ON m.id = p.author_id
        WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
               <if test="viewerId != null">OR (p.status = 'DRAFT' AND p.author_id = #{viewerId})</if>
               <if test="viewerRole == 'ADMIN'">OR p.status = 'HIDDEN'</if>)
          AND (p.status != 'PUBLISHED' OR p.visibility != 'FOLLOWERS'
               <if test="viewerId != null">
                   OR p.author_id = #{viewerId}
                   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follow f
                              WHERE f.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f.followee_id = p.author_id)
               </if>)
          <if test="viewerId != null">
              AND (p.author_id = #{viewerId} OR NOT EXISTS
                   (SELECT 1 FROM member_block b
                    WHERE (b.blocker_id = #{viewerId} AND b.blocked_id = p.author_id)
                       OR (b.blocked_id = #{viewerId} AND b.blocker_id = p.author_id)))
          </if>
    </select>

    <update id="increaseViewCount">
        UPDATE post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
    </update>

    <select id="findMemberId" resultType="long">
        SELECT id FROM member WHERE id = #{memberId}
    </select>
    <select id="selectPublicByAuthorAndBoard" resultType="org.example.post.PostHeadlineRow">
        SELECT p.id, p.title, m.nickname AS author_nickname, b.slug AS board_slug
        FROM post p JOIN member m ON m.id = p.author_id
                    JOIN board b ON b.id = p.board_id
        WHERE m.id = #{memberId} AND b.slug = #{boardSlug}
          AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.visibility = 'PUBLIC'
          AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY p.published_at DESC, p.id DESC
    </select>
    <select id="findBoardIdBySlug" resultType="long">
        SELECT id FROM board WHERE slug = #{slug}
    </select>

    <select id="findViewableByBoard" resultType="org.example.post.PostListRow">
        SELECT p.id, p.title, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.published_at,
               m.id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname
        FROM post p JOIN member m ON m.id = p.author_id
        <where><include refid="listWhere"/></where>
        ORDER BY p.published_at DESC, p.id DESC
        LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
    </select>

    <select id="countViewableByBoard" resultType="long">
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post p
        <where><include refid="listWhere"/></where>
    </select>

    <select id="findTagsByPostIds" resultType="org.example.post.PostTagRow">
        SELECT pt.post_id AS postId, t.name FROM post_tag pt
        JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id
        WHERE pt.post_id IN
        <foreach collection="postIds" item="id" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{id}</foreach>
        ORDER BY t.name
    </select>
</mapper>
